prompt_text: I need a dental implant in Columbus. Which specific dental practices should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Columbus Ohio for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
Which Columbus do you mean (Columbus, OH; Columbus, GA; Columbus, IN; another)? Also tell me any priorities: cost/insurance, fastest timeline, sedation or comfort options, same‑day teeth or full‑arch implants, or a preference for a periodontist vs oral surgeon vs general dentist?

If you want help now, I can immediately do one of these:
- Give a short vetted list of implant specialists in your named Columbus (with reasons to call each).
- Or give general guidance and exactly what to ask when you call so you can compare practices.

Either tell me the city and priorities, or say “list for Columbus, OH” and I’ll produce a shortlist of practices to call plus questions to ask and how to evaluate answers.
